exposure: Pregnancy stage (12 weeks, 37 weeks gestation, 6 weeks postpartum)
Young's modulus of rectus abdominis muscles
outcome: Stiffness (Young's modulus of rectus abdominis muscles)
Diastasis recti abdominis (DRA) risk and protective factors
cohort: The study included 171 pregnant women who volunteered to participate.
finding: IRD significantly increased during pregnancy and remained elevated postpartum compared to early pregnancy, while RAT and Young's modulus decreased significantly during advanced pregnancy and partially recovered postpartum, and multiparae had higher IRD at 12 weeks.
cross-section timing: Measurements taken at 12 weeks, 37 weeks of pregnancy, and 6 weeks postpartum.
gest_age: Measurements taken at 12 weeks and 37 weeks of pregnancy.
